Vampirism.title: Vampirism
Vampirism.description: You have obtained the power of a vampire

first_tick_commands: item replace entity @s weapon.mainhand with eop:dna_capsule{bloodsucker:"eop_true",display:{Name:'["",{"text":"Vampirism","color":"#ff0000","italic":false},{"text":" DNA Capsule","italic":false}]'}}
execute unless entity @s["vampirism:faction"="vampirism:vampire","vampirism:level"=0..] run vampirism level vampirism:vampire 1 @s

commands: execute if predicate eop:check_sky run effect give @s[gamemode=!creative] weakness 2 0 true
execute if predicate eop:check_sky run effect give @s[gamemode=!creative] mining_fatigue 2 0 true
execute if predicate eop:check_sky run effect give @s[gamemode=!creative] slowness 2 0 true
execute if predicate eop:check_sky run effect give @s[gamemode=!creative] eop:sunlight 2 0 true
